title: Two on/off switches have no activation gate in RUNBOOKS

source.ref: Site scan 2026-10-14 (scan nine, thread 'Site scan'), against origin/main eb26a01 and production.

detail: FILED 2026-10-14. SMS_PROVISIONING_ENABLED (lib/comms/sms.ts:112) and CONVERSATION_EMAIL_BRIDGE (lib/comms/inbound.ts:490) read envFlag and sit in .env.example (329, 369) but are missing from docs/RUNBOOKS.md, which AGENTS.md requires. .env.example:367 also says the value must be literally 'true' while envFlag takes 1/true/on. THE FIX: add both gates to RUNBOOKS and correct the comment.
